title: A merge that re-adds a line the branch's own diff deleted from docs/debts/notes.md is refused
why: A union merge of docs/debts/notes.md brings back lines a branch deleted (#1564, #1643, #1825/#1836). Folds in notes-union-resurrects from lane one-home-check (coordinator, 05:46 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix, if the silent-undo check misses it: a merge whose result re-adds a line the branch's own diff deleted refuses; red case first. Doing in lane lint-uses-pinned-tools (session_013NEJL1N3YkCMouc1pELXyu) as draft #1943 (coordinator, 05:15 and 05:46 CST Nov 8); lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run released its claim (05:47 CST). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Sighting 09:28 CST Nov 8 (lane timing-tests, session_013NEJL1jPC89ae6X6Pa4jmf, proposed step union-merge-revives-notes): merging #2002's head into #2081 kept an old copy of a note both sides rewrote, and revived a note #2081 had deleted; only a fix check caught it. The revived-note half matches this step; triage asked the lane at 09:28 CST to confirm, else it files union-merge-revives-notes apart.
